messages.subject: Starting values in lavaan
parts:
Dear all


I am completely new to lavaan (and also not that familiar with R). I ran my first model in lavaan just yesterday. I have a rather simple question that I hope somebody can help me with.


In the documentation it says:


“In the first case, all parameter values are set to zero, except the factor loadings (set to one), the variances of latent variables (set to 0.05), and the residual variances of observed variables (set to half the observed variance).”


Is this how lavaan choose the starting values? And does this apply in all settings?


Thanks, David
